decisions.reason: As a multi-variant organic flagship tied directly to the firm's announced organic expansion, it carries strong public commitment and justification pressure, so management will persist with it.
The line was extended in 2024 with new Classic and poultry variants, which signals continued investment, though its drop from a page of its own to a mere mention suggests some fading emphasis.

Launched in 2024 with a dedicated page as a new member of the organic team, it is too recent and too central to the organic direction to drop, since any weak results can be attributed to the start-up phase.
This freshly launched multi-variant organic line has a page of its own and fits the announced organic and new-format direction, so sunk costs and visible commitment favor keeping it.

It is a recent organic single item with its own page and is aligned with strategy, but as a single variant like the already discontinued organic snack B it is somewhat more vulnerable, though still likely retained.
